notes.title: MEANDERS - Extra Levels Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022492/9db3211fe64302f314f33ffdbe6299ce5e1e3211.gif[/img]
Hi all!
[b]Update 9 is live![/b]

[h1][b]NEW LEVELS AVAILABLE![/b][/h1]
With this update we introduce 10 new extra levels that we couldn't fit in the original game experience: hope you’ll enjoy them!!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022492/700be72172fca24dee50db1ef67bf2d237bc78d3.png[/img]
[h1][b]KITES IN THE SKY[/b][/h1]
The flying kites make their appearance! We’ve had them in mind for a while – the most attentive of you might have noticed them in the game’s art – but didn’t have a chance to introduce them since now. If you feel free like the wind or you want to give your dragons some company, give them a try.

[h1][b]RUSSIAN LOCALIZATION[/b][/h1]
Russian is now available for everyone and the efforts to localize the game continue day and night thanks to our amazing community!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022492/4cf9b2799aef699f7a1a3bcff455ed214e233a22.png[/img]

If you want to help, even just a bit, here's the link: http://atomicbreath.oneskyapp.com/
